items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: I've heard of him, but I never knew him.

ctx.x: It's been quite a while. Yeah. It's been a long time. Well, Nene ain't been dead.

Well, seven or eight years, I guess. A long time. See, to understand, I got Nene, he had a, was up there, had a barber shop, didn't he? I don't remember. I can't remember. Yeah, and he had a barber shop. I didn't even know him. About him. About him. About him. About him. About him. About him. About him. About him. About him.
About him. About him. About him. About him. You remember Louis Lillet? I know Louis Lillet, yeah. Much. Much, I know.
